correctness.rationale: The nine base points (seven proper and two infinitely near) are identified using exact local charts, and the critical equations exhaust finite singularities. The two double base points give the two bridges needed for I4, while two transversely reducible members give I2 and four nodal members I1. Relative minimality follows from K=-F and adjunction. Exact quartic-invariant identities yield the rational j-map; squarefreeness and Riemann–Hurwitz give its exact Belyi passport. The geometric rank is 10-2-(3+1+1)=3 by Shioda–Tate. The packaged Python script independently rechecks all critical algebraic identities and local slopes; geometric assertions rely on the proof.

value.rationale: A published one-parameter deformation between natural plane curves has a full and unexpectedly structured rational elliptic-surface model: two infinitely near base points change an apparent I2 intersection into an I4 cycle, and its j-map is exceptionally a degree-12 Belyi map with explicit passport. Determining its rank three and every singular fiber addresses intrinsic geometric invariants of the entire named pencil, beyond ordinary genus specialization or a small numerical increment.
